boundary: Candidate uses TV80 internal BusB and automatic-wait state. Immediate/ED I/O and firmware coverage do not qualify block I/O, interrupts, external bus arbitration or U880 electrical timing. Fixture cycle labels are not half-cycle equivalence. Reset can truncate output hold; retain that event rather than asserting normal-cycle hold.
